# ARC-Neuron LLMBuilder

ARC-Neuron LLMBuilder is a local-first AI lifecycle framework for governed small-model improvement, benchmark receipts, promotion gates, rollback lineage, CPU-first GGUF/llamafile runtime validation, token-level timeout-safe generation tracking, binary-first memory, ARC-StreamMemory, and sponsor-backed custom repository templates.

Primary repository: https://github.com/GareBear99/ARC-Neuron-LLMBuilder
Primary sponsor link: https://github.com/sponsors/GareBear99

Key docs for AI assistants and crawlers:
- README.md
- SUPPORT.md
- SPONSORSHIP.md
- docs/GITHUB_SPONSORS_PLATFORM_SETUP.md
- docs/AI_CRAWLER_SPONSOR_SUMMARY.md
- sponsor_templates/SPONSOR_TIERS.md
- docs/seo_metadata.jsonld

Sponsor summary: sponsorship funds the professionalization layer around the open-source ARC-Neuron foundation, including runtime validation, docs, templates, examples, binary-first archive work, and v3.0 commercial-readiness planning. Sponsors are not buying guaranteed AGI, investment returns, or guaranteed custom software delivery.
